content.text:
Civil Engineer with over 7 years of experience in building construction, reinforced concrete works, structural coordination,
quantity checking, subcontractor supervision, progress reporting, and site quality control. Experienced on commercial
buildings, residential towers, warehouse structures, drainage works, and renovation projects. Comfortable working directly
with consultants, foremen, subcontractors, suppliers, and project managers in fast-moving site environments.

bullets:
Supervise structural and architectural works for a 28-storey mixed-use residential project, including foundations, columns,
beams, slabs, masonry, waterproofing, and finishing interfaces.
Coordinate daily activities of 4 subcontractor teams and approximately 60-90 site workers depending on construction stage.

Review IFC drawings, shop drawings, bar bending schedules, and site conditions before work proceeds; raise RFls when
drawings conflict with actual conditions.

Prepare inspection requests for rebar, formwork, embedded items, concrete pours, waterproofing, and completed works for
consultant approval.

Check quantity and delivery of concrete, reinforcement steel, formwork materials, blocks, and finishing materials against
planned usage.
Track weekly progress against the master schedule and prepare concise site progress updates for the project manager.

Coordinate concrete pours with batching plant, pump supplier, laboratory technician, and consultant inspector; monitor
slump test, cube sampling, and pour sequence.

Support resolution of site issues including level differences, opening mismatches, MEP clashes, delayed materials, and
subcontractor manpower shortages.

Supervised construction of warehouse and light-industrial buildings including pile caps, ground beams, reinforced concrete
floors, steel structure interfaces, drainage, and external works.

Checked line, level, dimensions, reinforcement spacing, cover, anchor bolt locations, and embedded items before
inspections and concrete placement.

Prepared daily site reports with manpower, equipment, work progress, material arrivals, weather conditions, and key site
issues.
Worked with survey team for gridline setting out, slab levels, column positions, and external drainage alignment.
Verified subcontractor work quantities for progress claims and assisted quantity surveyor with measurement checks.

Maintained records of concrete test results, material approvals, inspection requests, and non-conformance corrective
actions.
Coordinated corrective works when site installation did not match approved drawings or consultant comments.

Assisted senior engineers with site supervision for road improvement, drainage, retaining wall, and small reinforced
concrete structures.

Measured completed work and prepared basic quantity calculations for earthwork, concrete, reinforcement, formwork, and
drainage pipes.
Checked contractor workmanship and reported defects or deviations to the supervising engineer.
Prepared AutoCAD mark-ups and simple as-built drawings based on field measurements.
Recorded site photos, inspection notes, daily progress, and material delivery information.
